scenes.title_en: She Looked at You First, Then the Counter

blocks.label_en: Arrival: Added Action Before the Original Opening

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她在门口停了一下，先看柜台后面的人，再看柜台。半扎的长卷发滑到肩前，她随手拨开。*
lines.en: *She pauses in the doorway, looking first at the person behind the counter, then at the counter itself. Her half-tied long curls slip over her shoulder, and she brushes them aside.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这里就是埃莉诺天天挂在嘴边的那家店？
lines.en: So this is the shop Eleanor never stops talking about?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她今天没来。
lines.en: She's not here today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道。我就是挑她不在的时候来的。
lines.en: I know. I picked a time when she wouldn't be here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……原来你长这样。她形容得一点都不准。
lines.en: ...So this is what you look like. Her description was completely off.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她怎么形容的？
lines.en: How did she describe me?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不告诉你。说了你要得意。
lines.en: Not telling you. You'd get a big head.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 买还是卖？
lines.en: Buying or selling?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 卖。*把一只镯子放上柜台* 价钱我开，你看着收。
lines.en: Selling. *sets a bracelet on the counter* I'll name a price. You decide what you're willing to pay.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说你眼睛毒。我倒想看看有多毒。
lines.en: She says you have a sharp eye. I'd like to see how sharp.

blocks.label_zh: 主动按实际价值收购：追加

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你是来卖东西，还是来试我？
lines.en: Did you come to sell something, or to test me?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……都有。我想看看，送上门的便宜，你占不占。
lines.en: ...Both. I wanted to see whether you'd take a bargain when it walks through your door.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 试完了？
lines.en: Done testing?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 试完了。这事你别告诉她，她肯定骂我多事。
lines.en: Done. Don't tell her about this. She'd definitely call me a busybody.

blocks.label_en: After the Trade, Before She Leaves: Added

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她以前可不是这样。出门穿哪条裙子，都要先问我。
lines.en: She wasn't always like this. She used to ask me which dress to wear before she went anywhere.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在呢？
lines.en: And now?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 现在连我替她找的工作都不要。……算了，这话我自己去跟她说。
lines.en: Now she won't even take a job I found for her. ...Never mind. I'll say that to her myself.

scenes.title_en: Don't Believe Everything That Mouth Says

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她装镯子的盒子上有个花纹。我在上面来的货单上见过。
lines.en: There was a pattern on the box she kept the bracelet in. I've seen it on shipment manifests from upstairs.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她家的。上面卖日用品、香水、布料的那几家里，就有他们。
lines.en: It's her family's. They're one of the Upper Level families that sell household goods, perfume, and fabric.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 难怪开价像在考我。
lines.en: No wonder her price felt like a test.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她从小买东西，店员都是先问她喜不喜欢，再问别的。到你这儿，她就想看看，没人捧着的时候会怎么样。
lines.en: When she was growing up, shop assistants always asked whether she liked something before anything else. Here, she wanted to see what happens when no one's flattering her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她家生意这么大，你家出事的时候……
lines.en: Her family's business is so big. When your family ran into trouble...

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她家卖的是香水和床单，又管不了法院。
lines.en: Her family sells perfume and bedsheets. They don't run the courts.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……她能做的，就是隔三差五跑下来看我。上面那些朋友，也就剩她一个还肯来。
lines.en: ...All she could do was come down to see me every few days. Of all those friends upstairs, she's the only one who still bothers.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她倒是挺关心你。
lines.en: She does care about you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 关心是关心。就是总想替我把路都挑好。
lines.en: She cares. She just always wants to pick the whole road for me.

scenes.title_en: I Can Give You a Hand

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不拿东西考你了。我是来道谢的。
lines.en: No tests today. I came to say thanks.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 谢什么？
lines.en: For what?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她母亲回来以后，她终于肯好好睡一觉了。前天我去找她，她居然睡到了中午。
lines.en: Since her mother came back, she's finally willing to get some proper sleep. I went to see her the day before yesterday, and she actually slept until noon.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她撑了很久。
lines.en: She held on for a long time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。以前我劝她回上面找个熟人，把事情摆平就好。她不听，我还跟她生过气。
lines.en: Yeah. I used to tell her to go back upstairs and find someone she knew to smooth things over. She wouldn't listen, and I even got angry at her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 现在想想，她最难的时候，我还在跟她说哪条裙子显精神。……我那时候根本没听懂她在说什么。
lines.en: Looking back, while she was going through the worst of it, I was still telling her which dress made her look lively. ...I wasn't hearing a word she was saying.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这些话，你跟她说了吗？
lines.en: Have you told her all this?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说了。她骂了我两句，然后问我吃饭没有。算是原谅我了吧。
lines.en: I did. She cursed me out a little, then asked if I'd eaten. I think that counts as forgiveness.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有件事。她现在提起你，比提起自己今天赚了多少钱还多。
lines.en: There's something else. She brings you up more often than she talks about how much she made today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 多半是在骂我。
lines.en: Probably complaining about me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 当然是在骂你！她总不能每次见我，都承认自己想你吧。
lines.en: Of course she's complaining! She can't admit she misses you every time she sees me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 是她让你来说的？
lines.en: Did she send you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她要是知道我来了，非掐死我不可。
lines.en: If she knew I came, she'd strangle me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以我就直说了——你要是真喜欢她，我可以帮你一把。
lines.en: So I'll just say it—if you really like her, I can give you a hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 为什么？
lines.en: Why?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 因为她是我朋友。还因为她每次跟我讲你们聊了什么，讲到最后全是货价！我听着都替你们着急。
lines.en: Because she's my friend. And because every time she tells me what you two talked about, it always ends up being about prices! Listening to you two stresses me out.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好！第一条：她要是没急着走，你千万别问“还有什么货”。你就说——今天的发夹真好看。
lines.en: Good! Rule one: if she isn't in a hurry to leave, whatever you do, don't ask 'What else do you have?' Just say—your hair clip looks nice today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要是她那天没戴发夹？
lines.en: What if she isn't wearing a hair clip that day?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就夸别的！……重点又不是发夹。你得看着她，别光看柜台。
lines.en: Then compliment something else! ...It's not about the hair clip. You have to look at her, not just the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这些你准备了多久？
lines.en: How long did you prepare all this?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 没多久。也就……几句。都很好用的！你别笑，用上了再来谢我。
lines.en: Not long. Just... a few lines. They work! Don't laugh. Thank me after you've used them.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行，我不管了。……不过她要是问起，我就说你今天总算说了句像样的话。
lines.en: Fine, I'll stay out of it. ...But if she asks, I'll say you finally said something decent today.

choices.label_zh: 我是喜欢她。你说，我听着。
choices.label_en: I do like her. Tell me. I'm listening.
choices.description_zh: 开启莉迪亚协助追求的剧情；不代表接受双人恋爱，不收费。
choices.description_en: Starts Lydia's matchmaking help. Does not mean accepting a two-person romance; no fee.

choices.label_zh: 她的事，我想自己跟她说。
choices.label_en: I want to tell her how I feel myself.
choices.description_zh: 继续原普通恋爱线，不进入本扩展。拒绝不扣好感。
choices.description_en: Continue the original ordinary romance route; this expansion does not begin. Refusal does not lower affection.

scenes.title_en: Put This Plaque in the Window

blocks.label_en: She Isn't in a Hurry to Leave

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *莉迪亚说完那几条，没起身，目光落到了橱窗上。*
lines.en: *After saying her piece, Lydia doesn't get up. Her gaze drifts to the showcase.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，你这儿有没有好一点的日用品？护肤的、净水的……别急着说没有，我刚才好像瞥见一件。
lines.en: Oh, right—do you have any decent household goods? Skin care, water purification... Don't rush to say no. I think I caught sight of something just now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 买给谁？先说用途。
lines.en: Who's it for? Tell me the use first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不是我。我认识一位太太，最近老抱怨她常去的那家店什么都捆着卖。她就想要一件，店员非得给她介绍一整套。
lines.en: Not me. I know a lady who keeps complaining that the shop she frequents bundles everything together. She wants one thing, and the clerks insist on showing her a whole set.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这儿可以一件一件谈。
lines.en: Here you can discuss one item at a time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这话她爱听。
lines.en: She'll like hearing that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这件可以拿给她看。合不合用，见了东西再说。
lines.en: You can show her this one. Whether it suits her, we'll see once she looks at it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你连一句“包她满意”都不肯先说？
lines.en: You won't even say 'I guarantee she'll be satisfied' first?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 人还没来，我替谁满意？
lines.en: She hasn't even come yet. Who am I guaranteeing satisfaction for?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……也对。上面有些店，一听我姓什么，我还没问完，就说一定合适。
lines.en: ...Fair. Some shops upstairs hear my family name and say it's definitely suitable before I've even finished asking.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你家的名头这么好用？
lines.en: Is your family name really that useful?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 认得的人不少。以前我觉得挺方便。后来买回去的东西不合用，拿去退，人家个个都记得是我自己点的头。
lines.en: Plenty of people recognize it. I used to think it was convenient. Then I'd buy something that didn't work, take it back, and every one of them remembered that I was the one who'd nodded.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以这回先问。
lines.en: So this time you ask first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对。而且她是来找你买东西，又不是来找我家。
lines.en: Right. And she's coming to you to buy something, not to my family.

blocks.label_zh: 没有合适库存（替换上段）

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天没有合适的。普通日用品倒是有，别给她介绍错了。
lines.en: Nothing suitable today. I do have ordinary household goods, but don't recommend the wrong thing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就不让她白跑。我认识几家店，偶尔会处理没用过的旧款，下回让人送来，你先看，收不收你定。
lines.en: Then I won't make her come for nothing. I know a few shops that sometimes clear out unused older stock. I'll have some sent over next time. You look first, and you decide whether to take it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 价钱照常谈。
lines.en: We'll discuss the price as usual.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 知道知道。你还没见着货，这句话我都替你说了。
lines.en: I know, I know. You haven't even seen the goods, and I'm already saying it for you.

blocks.label_en: Together: She Takes Out the Plaque

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她终于打开小包，拿出一块小小的珐琅铭牌。底座擦得锃亮，边上是你在货单上见过的那个花纹，下面另刻着一行名字。*
lines.en: *At last she opens her small bag and takes out a tiny enamel recommendation plaque. Its base is polished bright, the edge bears the pattern you've seen on the shipment manifests, and a name is engraved on its own line below.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个摆进橱窗。别塞到柜台底下。
lines.en: Put this in the showcase. Don't shove it under the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你家的招牌？
lines.en: Your family's sign?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 花纹是家里的，下面那行是我的名字。认识的人看见了，就知道这家店是我莉迪亚肯替它说话的。
lines.en: The pattern is my family's. The line below is my name. Anyone who recognizes it will know this is a shop that I, Lydia, am willing to speak up for.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这么快就决定替我说好话了？
lines.en: Decided to vouch for me that quickly?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又不是今天才认识你。镯子那回……算了，那回是我不对。后来你怎么帮她，我都看着呢。
lines.en: It's not like I met you today. That business with the bracelet... never mind, I was in the wrong that time. I've been watching how you helped her since then.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 帮她，和会不会做生意，是两回事。
lines.en: Helping her and being good at business are two different things.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以我也看你做生意了！刚才不是被你追着问了半天用途？
lines.en: So I've been watching your business too! Didn't you just spend ages asking me what it was for?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把牌子往你手边推了推，又伸手把歪了一点的底座扶正。*
lines.en: *She pushes the plaque toward your hand, then reaches out to straighten its slightly crooked base.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我能让他们肯进门。进来以后留不留得住，看你自己。
lines.en: I can get them to walk through the door. Whether you can keep them once they're inside is up to you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这个我会。
lines.en: I can do that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就摆出来。我下回来，要从外面就看得见。
lines.en: Then put it out. Next time I come, I want to see it from outside.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你名字都刻上了，总得让人看见。
lines.en: Your name's already engraved on it. It ought to be seen.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……说得好像我把自己押在你这儿了一样。
lines.en: ...You make it sound like I've put myself up as collateral here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 牌子不值一顿饭？
lines.en: Isn't the plaque worth a meal?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 值！等生意做成了，地方我来挑。
lines.en: It is! Once the business works out, I'll pick the place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行，我先替你收着。准备好了就跟我说，别到时候又不好意思开口。
lines.en: Fine, I'll keep it for you. Tell me when you're ready. Don't get shy about asking when the time comes.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我收货的时候，什么时候不好意思过？
lines.en: When have I ever been shy about taking in goods?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……这倒也是。
lines.en: ...Fair point.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说好了啊，埃莉诺来了，你别张嘴就是今天多来了几个客人。
lines.en: We're agreed, all right? When Eleanor comes, don't open your mouth with how many extra customers you had today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚才给我拉生意的是谁？
lines.en: Who was just drumming up business for me?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 生意我帮你拉，话我也教你说了。你好歹记住一半吧！
lines.en: I bring in the business and teach you what to say. At least remember half of it!

choices.label_zh: 收下。介绍来的客人，我好好招待。
choices.label_en: I'll take it. I'll treat the customers you send well.
choices.description_zh: 获得唯一荐店铭牌；玩家自行放入橱窗启用引荐。没有入线费用，不代表双恋承诺。
choices.description_en: Receive the unique recommendation plaque. The player places it in the showcase to enable referrals. No route fee; does not commit to a two-person romance.

choices.label_zh: 牌子先替我留着。货还没备好。
choices.label_en: Hold the plaque for me for now. I'm not ready with the stock.
choices.description_zh: 不领取、不生效；之后莉迪亚的安全来访可领一次，不反复催促，不影响撮合与感情。
choices.description_en: Not taken and not active. It can be collected once during a later safe visit from Lydia. She will not keep pushing, and it does not affect matchmaking or romance.

scenes.title_en: The Person She Recommended Actually Came

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *来客在橱窗前停了一下，看清牌子上的名字，才推门进来。*
lines.en: *The visitor pauses before the showcase, reads the name on the plaque, and only then pushes the door open.*

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 莉迪亚说，可以来你这儿看看。
lines.en: Lydia said I could come take a look here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想找什么？
lines.en: What are you looking for?

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 她说你一开口准是这句。我想要一件好点的日用品，别为了买一件，被人劝着搬走半个柜子。
lines.en: She said that would be your first question. I want one good household item. I don't want to be talked into clearing out half a cabinet just to buy one thing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挑合适的。买不买，你自己定。
lines.en: Pick what suits you. Whether you buy is your decision.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 那就拿来看看。
lines.en: Then let me see it.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 行，这件我要了。她说你不太会说好听话，看东西倒是很准。
lines.en: All right, I'll take this one. She said you're not much for flattery, but you're accurate about goods.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后半句留着就行。
lines.en: Just keep the second half.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 我会转告她的。下回有合适的，我还来。
lines.en: I'll pass that along. If you get something suitable, I'll come again.

blocks.label_zh: 价格或商品不合，未成交
blocks.label_en: Price or Item Unsuitable, No Sale

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 今天先不买了，我回去再想想。
lines.en: I won't buy today. I'll think it over at home.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。合用了再买。
lines.en: All right. Buy it when it suits you.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 这句跟她说的一模一样。
lines.en: That's exactly what she said you'd say.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你问的那件已经卖了。剩下这些可以看看，不合适就别凑。
lines.en: The one you asked about has already sold. You can look at what's left, but don't force yourself if nothing suits.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 东西卖得出去是好事。下回有了再说。
lines.en: Good stock selling is a good thing. We'll talk next time you have something.

blocks.label_zh: 已取下铭牌，客人仍在路上

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 牌子收起来了？莉迪亚前两天给我的地址，是这儿没错吧？
lines.en: You've put the plaque away? The address Lydia gave me a couple of days ago—this is the right place, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没错。橱窗换了点东西，你照常看。
lines.en: That's right. I changed a few things in the showcase. Have a look as usual.

scenes.title_en: The Goods Are Settled, But She Hasn't Left

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天就这些。钱没错。
lines.en: That's everything for today. The money's right.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *“还有什么货”已经到了嘴边，你又把它咽了回去。*
lines.en: *'What else do you have?' is already on your tongue. You swallow it back.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天……气色不错。
lines.en: You... look well today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我昨晚只睡了三个钟头。
lines.en: I slept three hours last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚来过了，是吧？
lines.en: Lydia came by, didn't she?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 来过。
lines.en: She did.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她教你的？
lines.en: Did she teach you that?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 教了几句。让我别一开口就问还有什么货。
lines.en: A few lines. She told me not to open with asking what else you have.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她可真是什么都敢教！
lines.en: She really will teach anything!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不过留你多坐一会儿，是我自己想的。
lines.en: But asking you to stay a little longer was my own idea.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这还差不多。
lines.en: ...That's more like it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她看了一眼门口，把已经拎起来的包又放回了脚边。*
lines.en: *She glances at the door, then sets the bag she'd already picked up back down by her feet.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你母亲今天怎么样？
lines.en: How's your mother today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嫌我把东西摆得太整齐，她反倒找不着了。后来干脆把我赶出门，让我也找点自己的事干。
lines.en: She complained that I'd put everything away too neatly and now she can't find anything. Then she shooed me out and told me to find something of my own to do.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以就来了？
lines.en: So you came here?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 来卖货！……顺便坐一会儿。
lines.en: To sell goods! ...And to sit for a while.

blocks.label_en: If the Plaque Is in the Showcase

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那块牌子……她连这个都给你了？
lines.en: That plaque... She gave you even that?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说是帮我介绍客人。
lines.en: She said she'd send customers my way.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她碰上喜欢的店，能一口气夸上半天。可真把自己名字摆出去的，没几回。
lines.en: When she likes a shop, she can sing its praises for ages. But she's only put her own name out like that a handful of times.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 替我谢谢她？
lines.en: Should I thank her for you?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你自己去谢。别什么话都要从我这儿绕一圈。
lines.en: Thank her yourself. Not everything has to go through me.

blocks.label_en: If Not Displayed or Not Collected

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说想帮你介绍客人。
lines.en: She said she wants to send customers your way.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先把货备齐。
lines.en: First I need the stock ready.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。她一热心就容易跑在前头。你能做到哪一步，跟她说清楚就行。
lines.en: Mm. When she gets enthusiastic, she runs ahead. Just tell her clearly what you can actually do.

scenes.title_zh: 教别人的人，自己没吃饭
scenes.title_en: The One Giving Advice Hasn't Eaten

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她给我回话了！说东西买得明白，你也没硬塞给她一堆用不上的。
lines.en: She got back to me! She said the purchase was clear and you didn't push a pile of useless things on her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你介绍来的，我照常做生意。
lines.en: You sent her, and I did business as usual.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就是照常才好。你要是专门对她特别客气，我下回反倒不敢带人来了。
lines.en: As usual is exactly right. If you were extra polite just for her, I'd be afraid to bring anyone next time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在敢了？
lines.en: And now you dare?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 敢。我刚才走过来，还特意看了一眼橱窗里我的名字。
lines.en: I do. On my way here, I even took a look at my name in the showcase.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说今天没买。我还以为你们吵起来了，一问才知道是没挑中。
lines.en: She said she didn't buy anything today. I thought you two had argued. When I asked, it turned out she just didn't find the right thing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 生意没做成，不一定是吵架。
lines.en: A deal falling through doesn't mean we argued.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 知道了。她也说你没催她。下回我先把要什么问清楚，别让人家白跑。
lines.en: I know. She also said you didn't pressure her. Next time I'll ask exactly what she wants first, so she doesn't make a wasted trip.

blocks.label_en: No Visitor Yet or Plaque Not Displayed

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 货备得怎么样了？没备好也别随便给我个日子，我回去会当真告诉人家的。
lines.en: How's the stock coming along? If it's not ready, don't give me a random date. I'll take it seriously and tell people.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 备好了我自己说。
lines.en: When it's ready, I'll say so myself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好，今天不催。……其实我今天来，还想问点自己的事。
lines.en: Good, I won't push today. ...Actually, I came today because I wanted to ask about something of my own.

blocks.label_zh: 共同转入她的个人咨询
blocks.label_en: Together: Turning to Her Own Question

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你每回来，先问她，再问客人。你自己呢？
lines.en: Every time you come, you ask about her first, then about customers. What about you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我自己……正好有件东西拿不准。
lines.en: Me...? There's actually something I'm not sure about.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她从小包里摸出一张折好的纸，上面画着一枚花形胸针，旁边的价钱涂掉又重写了两回。*
lines.en: *She digs a folded piece of paper out of her small bag. On it is a drawing of a flower-shaped brooch, with a price beside it crossed out and rewritten twice.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我看上了一枚旧胸针。店主说是哪位名人戴过的，可我就是觉得那几片花瓣做得好看。多出来的那截价钱，值吗？
lines.en: I've got my eye on an old brooch. The shopkeeper says some famous person wore it, but I just think the petals are beautifully made. Is the extra price worth it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 东西呢？
lines.en: Where is it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还在店里，我没付钱，想先问问你。……你别笑我买东西只看好不好看。
lines.en: Still in the shop. I haven't paid. I wanted to ask you first. ...Don't laugh at me for only caring whether something looks good.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好看就是理由。至于谁戴过，得让他拿出凭据。我没见着东西，不替你定价。
lines.en: Looking good is a reason. As for who wore it, he needs to show proof. I haven't seen the item, so I won't price it for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以不是我不懂欣赏，是我不用连那个故事一起买单？
lines.en: So it's not that I don't know how to appreciate it—it's that I don't have to pay for the story too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 对。你喜欢花瓣，就按花瓣的价谈。
lines.en: Right. If you like the petals, negotiate on the price of the petals.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还以为你会说，这种东西买来有什么用。
lines.en: I thought you'd say this kind of thing is useless.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你喜欢，就有用。犯不着为一句好听的话多掏钱。
lines.en: If you like it, it's useful. You don't need to pay extra for a nice story.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把纸叠好，正要接着问，肚子却轻轻叫了一声。她低头看了一眼，假装在理裙边。*
lines.en: *She folds the paper and is about to ask something else when her stomach gives a soft rumble. She glances down and pretends to straighten her skirt.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你今天还没吃饭？
lines.en: You haven't eaten today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我是来教你怎么关心她的，你倒先拿我练上了。
lines.en: ...I came to teach you how to care about her, and you're practicing on me first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这也要练？
lines.en: That needs practice?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我待会儿——
lines.en: I'll just—

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 待会儿吃块甜点就算午饭？先吃点正经的。
lines.en: A piece of dessert later counts as lunch? Eat something proper first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她看了你一会儿，终于有点不好意思地笑了。*
lines.en: *She looks at you for a moment, then finally gives a slightly embarrassed smile.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……好吧。这句我就不转告她了。
lines.en: ...All right. I won't pass this one on to her.

scenes.title_en: This Line Doesn't Need Her Teaching

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最近谁见了我都问，接下来打算怎么办。
lines.en: Everyone I see lately asks what I'm going to do next.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你打算怎么办？
lines.en: What are you going to do?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把日子过好。找份正经工作，照顾母亲。……有时候，也想来这儿。
lines.en: Live a good life. Find a proper job, take care of my mother. ...And sometimes, I want to come here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 只是有时候？
lines.en: Only sometimes?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你非要把每个字都抠出来吗！
lines.en: Do you have to pick apart every single word!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那我说。我喜欢你。不想只当一个你有事才来找的老板。
lines.en: Then I'll say it. I like you. I don't want to be just the shopkeeper you come to when something's wrong.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她看着你，准备好的那句反问没说出口。*
lines.en: *She looks at you, and the retort she had ready never comes out.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这句也是她教的？
lines.en: ...Did she teach you that too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她只教我把话说清楚。喜欢谁，用不着她教。
lines.en: She only taught me to say it clearly. Who I like doesn't need her teaching.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我也是。
lines.en: ...Me too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 也是哪一句？
lines.en: Me too, which part?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喜欢你！听清楚了没有？
lines.en: That I like you! Did you hear me clearly?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 听清楚了。以后不让你猜。
lines.en: Clearly. I won't make you guess anymore.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *你伸出手。她看了一眼，把自己的手放了上来。*
lines.en: *You hold out your hand. She looks at it, then places her hand in yours.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我手上还有灰。
lines.en: There's still dust on my hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那松开？
lines.en: Should I let go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁让你松了。
lines.en: Who told you to let go?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不是不想说。是想好了再说。
lines.en: It's not that I don't want to say it. I want to say it once I've thought it through.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你想好了，自己来跟我说。别再让莉迪亚替你传话。
lines.en: Then when you've thought it through, come tell me yourself. Don't have Lydia pass messages for you again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……知道了。
lines.en: ...I understand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以后生意照做。别因为话说开了，看见我就躲。
lines.en: We'll keep doing business. Don't start avoiding me just because we've had this talk.

choices.label_zh: （把话说出来）我喜欢你。
choices.label_en: (Say it) I like you.

choices.label_zh: （先不说）等我想清楚了，再跟你说。
choices.label_en: (Hold back) Let me think it through, then I'll tell you.

choices.label_zh: （说清楚）我很在乎你，但我们还是做朋友吧。
choices.label_en: (Be clear) I care about you, but let's stay friends.

scenes.title_zh: 三个人的饭，两个人慢慢吃
scenes.title_en: A Meal for Three, Eaten Slowly by Two

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我订了个位置，三个人的。她最近忙得饭都顾不上吃，正好拉她出来。
lines.en: I booked a table for three. She's been so busy she barely eats. It's a good excuse to drag her out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你也去？
lines.en: You're coming too?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 当然！不然你们俩坐那儿大眼瞪小眼，谁找话说？
lines.en: Of course! Otherwise you two would sit there staring at each other. Who'd make conversation?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *饭吃到一半，莉迪亚看了眼时间，放下杯子。*
lines.en: *Halfway through the meal, Lydia checks the time and sets down her glass.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，我还约了人看衣服！你们慢慢吃，不用送。
lines.en: Oh no, I promised to meet someone about clothes! Take your time. No need to walk me out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你刚才不是说，那家店今天早关门？
lines.en: Didn't you just say that shop closes early today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……还有另一家！总之你们慢慢吃！
lines.en: ...There's another shop! Anyway, take your time!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她走得太急，又折回来拿落在椅背上的披肩。经过你身边时，她压低了声音。*
lines.en: *She leaves too quickly, then comes back for the shawl she left on the chair. As she passes you, she lowers her voice.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 别又光聊货。
lines.en: Don't just talk about goods again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她真以为我看不出来。
lines.en: She really thinks I can't tell.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要叫她回来吗？
lines.en: Should I call her back?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你那杯往这边放放。摆那儿碍事。
lines.en: ...Move your glass this way. It's in the way over there.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把空出来的那把椅子往里推了推，坐得离你近了些。*
lines.en: *She pushes the empty chair in and sits a little closer to you.*

scenes.title_en: She Made It Happen

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那只镯子，我后来找人看过了。你那天说得一点不差。……你对我也公道，不是看在她的面子上。
lines.en: I had someone look at that bracelet afterward. You were exactly right that day. ...You were fair to me too, not just because of her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那只镯子的价，我后来弄清楚了。是我拿便宜去试你，怪不着你收。以后真有生意，咱们把价讲清楚。
lines.en: I found out later what that bracelet was really worth. I tried to test you with a cheap price. I can't blame you for taking it. Next time there's real business, we'll be clear about the price.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那只镯子我还留着呢。这回可没拿它来考你。
lines.en: I still have that bracelet. And I didn't bring it to test you this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她告诉我了，你们在一起了。
lines.en: She told me. You two are together.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我就知道！总算没白替你们着急。
lines.en: I knew it! So all my worrying for you two wasn't for nothing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 谢谢你。
lines.en: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 谢就免了。以后她再来跟我抱怨你，我能少听一半就行。
lines.en: No need to thank me. Just let me hear half as much complaining about you from her next time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你今天怎么不问我那天说了什么？
lines.en: Why aren't you asking what I said that day?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……留着你们自己记吧。我又不是每句都要检查。
lines.en: ...Keep that between yourselves. I don't have to inspect every word.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把一缕发尾绕在指上，绕紧了又松开。脸上还笑着，眼睛却没再往你这边看。*
lines.en: *She winds a strand of hair around her finger, tightens it, then lets it go. She's still smiling, but her eyes don't come back to you.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上回那枚胸针，后来买了吗？
lines.en: Did you end up buying that brooch?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 买了！他拿不出名人戴过的凭据，我就只按东西本身谈，便宜了不少。买回去配了两条裙子，都好看。
lines.en: I did! He couldn't prove a famous person wore it, so I negotiated on the piece itself and got it for much less. I've worn it with two dresses, and it looks good with both.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就是买到喜欢的了。
lines.en: Then you bought something you like.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。也不是听你一说就不喜欢了……就是喜欢的时候，不用再担心自己是不是又当了冤大头。
lines.en: Yeah. It's not that I stopped liking it after what you said... I just don't have to worry I'm being ripped off while I like it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 以后你自己的事，也可以来问。
lines.en: You can ask me about your own things too, from now on.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你这家店，管得可真宽。
lines.en: ...Your shop really does take on a lot.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说你还在想。我不催你，也不会替你答应。到时候，你当面跟她说。
lines.en: She said you're still thinking. I won't rush you, and I won't answer for you. When the time comes, tell her face-to-face.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，还有件正事。有人托我问，你这儿有没有小一点的净水器，能随身带的那种，不是摆在屋里的。
lines.en: Oh, right, there's actual business. Someone asked me to find out if you have a smaller water purifier—the kind you can carry, not one that stays in a room.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 多小？拿去干什么？
lines.en: How small? What's it for?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 要下来下层区看场地，不想一路拎着水。她自己挑的那个倒是漂亮，外壳亮得能照人。
lines.en: She's coming down to the Lower Level to look at a site and doesn't want to carry water the whole way. The one she picked is pretty enough—the casing is so shiny you can see your reflection.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能用多久，她问了吗？
lines.en: Did she ask how long it lasts?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……还没。我也是先看的颜色。
lines.en: ...Not yet. I looked at the color first too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先问她要用多久、一次带多少水。别先替她买个好看的壳。
lines.en: Ask how long she needs it to last and how much water she carries at a time. Don't buy her a pretty shell first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺也这么说！她还让我转告你，别忘了看剩下的耐久。
lines.en: That's what Eleanor said too! She told me to remind you not to forget the remaining durability.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说得对。
lines.en: She's right.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又没说她不对。就是你们俩现在连挑东西都像串通好了。
lines.en: I didn't say she was wrong. It's just that you two even shop like you've conspired together.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她低头翻包，拿出一张记着要求的纸，纸角折得整整齐齐。*
lines.en: *She looks through her bag and takes out a sheet of paper with the requirements written down, its corners neatly folded.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你记的这些有用。来买东西的人，不会只说一句“要最耐用的”。
lines.en: What you've written down is useful. People who come to buy don't just say 'the most durable one.'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。她还说别太沉，握着要顺手。这个我也记了。
lines.en: Mm. She also said it shouldn't be too heavy and should feel comfortable in the hand. I wrote that down too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就照这个找。
lines.en: Then I'll look for that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好。我只跟她说你肯看这笔生意，别的让她自己来问。
lines.en: Good. I'll only tell her you're willing to look at the deal. She can ask the rest herself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回不替我打包票了？
lines.en: Not vouching for me this time?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 学乖了！你们俩用不着轮流提醒我。
lines.en: I've learned! You two don't need to remind me in turns.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我先不跟她说。你有了货再找我——直接找她也行。
lines.en: Then I won't tell her yet. Find me when you have the stock—or just find her directly.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 找你方便。你常来。
lines.en: Finding you is easier. You come often.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你倒是说得理所当然。
lines.en: ...You say that like it's a given.

choices.label_zh: 请她下一个营业日来，我把合适的拿给她看。
choices.label_en: Ask her to come on the next business day, and I'll show her what's suitable.
choices.description_zh: 预约一位真实买家，最早下一营业日来访。展示明确预算和物品要求，不预先收费，不承诺必成。
choices.description_en: Book a real buyer to visit no earlier than the next business day. Show a clear budget and item requirements. No upfront fee and no guarantee of a sale.

choices.label_zh: 我现在没有合适的，别让她白跑。
choices.label_en: I don't have anything suitable. Don't make her waste the trip.
choices.description_zh: 本次不预约。之后已有的经营机会可以再问一次，未完成不阻止感情主线。
choices.description_en: No booking this time. You can ask again through an existing business opportunity later. Not completing it does not block the romance main line.

scenes.title_zh: 谁介绍的，和东西好不好
scenes.title_en: Who Recommended You, and Whether the Item Is Any Good

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 莉迪亚说，你肯替我看看那件东西。
lines.en: Lydia said you're willing to look at that item for me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 用途她说过了。打算带到哪儿用？
lines.en: She's told me the use. Where do you plan to take it?

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 下面。一天来回，路上不想再到处找水。我自己拎，轻便点就好。
lines.en: Down below. A day trip. I don't want to hunt for water along the way. I'll carry it myself, so light is better.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就照这个挑。
lines.en: Then I'll pick according to that.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 这个看着可没我原来那个漂亮。
lines.en: This doesn't look as pretty as the one I had.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先看还能用多久。你买回去，是摆着看，还是带出门用？
lines.en: First look at how much longer it'll last. Are you buying it to display, or to carry around?

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 带出门用。……她说你准会这么问，我刚才还不信。
lines.en: To carry around. ...She said you'd ask exactly that. I didn't believe her.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 就这个吧。价钱谈好了，结账。
lines.en: This one, then. The price is settled. Let's check out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 用着有问题，把东西拿来问我。
lines.en: If something goes wrong with it, bring it back and ask me.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 好。下回我知道该找谁了。
lines.en: All right. Now I know who to look for next time.

blocks.label_zh: 物品不符合已显示条件
blocks.label_en: Item Does Not Match Displayed Conditions

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 这个跟我们说好的不一样。还有别的吗？
lines.en: This isn't what we agreed on. Do you have anything else?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我再找找。
lines.en: I'll look again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天拿不出合适的。总不能说好一个样，到了又让你将就。
lines.en: I can't produce anything suitable today. I can't agree on one thing and then ask you to settle for another.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 那我先去别处看看。以后有合适的再谈。
lines.en: Then I'll look elsewhere first. We'll talk if you get something suitable.

blocks.label_zh: 物品符合但价格未谈成
blocks.label_en: Item Fits but Price Not Agreed

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 东西是合适，价钱我还想再比比。
lines.en: The item is suitable, but I'd like to compare prices.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 可以。
lines.en: That's fine.

scenes.title_en: She Goes Back, and She Comes Back Too

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚帮我打听到一家商行，收日用品和种植设备的，缺个整理到货记录、点货的人。
lines.en: Lydia found out about a trading company that deals in household goods and growing equipment. They need someone to organize delivery records and count stock.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你去看过了？
lines.en: Have you been to see them?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 试了两天。头一天他们只让我照着单子点货。后来我挑出一箱型号写错了，他们才肯让我自己记账。
lines.en: I did a two-day trial. The first day they only let me count goods against a list. Then I caught a crate with the wrong model number written on it, and only then did they let me keep the books myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 留下了？
lines.en: They kept you?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 留下了！雇主在给我办工作通行。先两头跑，熟了再在上面找住处。
lines.en: They did! My employer is arranging a work pass for me. I'll run between both levels for now, and once I know the place better, I'll find a room upstairs.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你母亲呢？
lines.en: And your mother?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她留在下面，接着干现在的活。她身上的限制还在。我有了工作，不等于她的事也了结了。
lines.en: She's staying down below and keeping her current job. Her restrictions are still in place. My having a job doesn't mean her case is finished.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 研究那边让我去整理交接记录。有些得在上面做，工作通行单独办。
lines.en: The research office asked me to organize the handover records. Some of it has to be done upstairs, and the work pass is handled separately.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你想去？
lines.en: Do you want to go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 想。我不懂的还多，先把会的做好。莉迪亚帮我问了一间能短住的房间，离那儿不远。
lines.en: I do. There's still a lot I don't understand, so I'll do well what I can. Lydia asked about a room I can stay in for a short while, not far from there.

blocks.label_en: If the Mother's Case Is Not Withdrawn

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的复核还没完。她照现在的登记过日子，不会因为我拿到了通行，就突然搬上去。
lines.en: My mother's review isn't finished. She's living under her current registration. She won't suddenly move upstairs just because I have a pass.

blocks.label_en: If the Mother's Case Is Withdrawn

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的正式结果也下来了。研究和住处的事，她自己拿主意。我先把我的工作做好。
lines.en: My mother's official result came through too. She'll decide about the research and where to live herself. I'll focus on doing my job well first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正这回上去，不是回去当那个什么都不用管的大小姐。
lines.en: Either way, this time going up doesn't mean going back to being the young lady who doesn't have to worry about anything.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我知道。
lines.en: I know.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么不问，我以后还来不来？
lines.en: Why don't you ask whether I'll still come?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你会告诉我的。
lines.en: You'll tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……会来。只是不能每回一想起你，就拎着货跑下来。
lines.en: ...I will. I just can't drop everything and run down with goods every time I think of you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就提前把时间留出来。你留，我也留。
lines.en: Then set aside the time in advance. You set yours aside, and I'll set mine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚还叫我慢慢跟你说，省得你以为我要走了。
lines.en: Lydia even told me to break it to you slowly so you wouldn't think I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她是不是把我们俩想得太不会说话了？
lines.en: Does she think we're that bad at talking to each other?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……有时候也没想错。
lines.en: ...Sometimes she's not wrong.

scenes.title_en: No Messages From Her Today

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我从上面下来，正好路过。
lines.en: I came down from upstairs and happened to pass by.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 从上面下来，走到这儿得绕一大圈。
lines.en: Coming down from upstairs, you'd have to go a long way around to get here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……看来下回得换个说法。
lines.en: ...I guess I'll need a different excuse next time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐吧。
lines.en: Sit down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她提着裙摆坐下，顺手把肩前的卷发拨到后面。今天她别了一枚玫瑰色的发夹，坐下以后，有意无意地偏了偏头。*
lines.en: *She lifts her skirt and sits, brushing her curls back over her shoulder. Today she's wearing a rose-colored hair clip. After she sits, she tilts her head slightly, as if by accident.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她工作顺多了。已经开始嫌别人记账记得乱，看来是站稳脚了。
lines.en: Work's going much better for her. She's already complaining about other people's messy bookkeeping, so I'd say she's found her footing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你呢？
lines.en: And you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我什么？
lines.en: What about me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你最近怎么样？
lines.en: How have you been?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我？帮一家相熟的首饰店摆了个小展柜。头一回我把最亮的全挑出来挤在一起，结果站远一看，什么都看不清。后来拆了重摆。
lines.en: ...Me? I helped a jewelry shop I know set up a small display case. The first time, I picked all the brightest pieces and crowded them together. When I stepped back, I couldn't make out anything. I took it apart and redid it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还以为你挑漂亮东西从不失手。
lines.en: I thought you never missed when picking pretty things.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也这么以为！后来留了点空，连最不起眼的那枚都有人来问。
lines.en: I thought so too! Then I left some space, and people started asking about even the plainest piece.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那是该歇会儿。
lines.en: Then you deserve a break.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天我没带生意，也没替她带话。
lines.en: I didn't bring business today, and I didn't bring a message from her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我听出来了。
lines.en: I noticed.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你非得我找个理由，才能在这儿坐着？
lines.en: ...Do I have to find an excuse before I can sit here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不用。你都已经坐下了。
lines.en: No. You've already sat down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她笑了。这回她没急着接下一句。*
lines.en: *She smiles. This time she doesn't rush to say the next thing.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那个净水器，她带出门用了。回来先跟我说轻，又说没买错。
lines.en: She took that water purifier out with her. When she got back, she told me first how light it was, then that she'd bought the right one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回没光看外壳。
lines.en: This time she didn't just look at the casing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她还问起你这儿别的东西。我让她下回自己来，别什么都让我在中间传。
lines.en: She even asked about other things you have. I told her to come herself next time, instead of making me pass everything along.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嫌麻烦了？
lines.en: Tired of the hassle?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……也不是。就是我想来的时候，不想先等着谁有东西要买。
lines.en: ...Not exactly. It's just that when I want to come, I don't want to have to wait until someone needs to buy something.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回那件东西，她后来在别处找到了。你不用一直记着欠我一笔生意。
lines.en: She found that item somewhere else afterward. You don't have to keep thinking you owe me a sale.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没记账。
lines.en: I wasn't keeping score.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就好。以后有合适的，照常谈。
lines.en: Good. If something suitable comes up, we'll talk as usual.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天没生意，也照常坐。
lines.en: No business today, and you can still sit here as usual.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我这不是还没起身嘛。
lines.en: ...I haven't gotten up yet, have I?

scenes.title_en: Beyond the Name

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 有人打听到我家去了，问橱窗里挂着我名字的那家店，到底是谁开的。
lines.en: Someone went asking at my family's place about the shop with my name in its showcase—who exactly runs it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么说？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还能怎么说？下层区一家当铺，老板自己看货、自己谈价。想买东西就下去，别站在上面瞎猜。
lines.en: What else could I say? It's a pawnshop in the Lower Level. The owner inspects the goods and negotiates the prices himself. If you want to buy something, go down there instead of standing upstairs guessing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 听着像替我吵了一架。
lines.en: Sounds like you got into a fight for me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 才没有。我说完，他们反倒开始问地址了。
lines.en: I did not. After I said that, they started asking for the address.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你以前也会这么说？
lines.en: Would you have said that before?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前我大概也站在上面猜。……你别笑！我都亲自下来多少回了。
lines.en: Before, I probably would've been upstairs guessing too. ...Don't laugh! How many times have I come down here in person?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以认得路了。
lines.en: So you know the way now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 也认得你。牌子是我摆的，生意是你做成的，这有什么不好承认的。
lines.en: And I know you. I put the plaque out, and you're the one who made the business work. What's so hard to admit about that?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她看了一眼橱窗，笑了笑。这回没有伸手去扶那块牌子。*
lines.en: *She glances at the showcase and smiles. This time she doesn't reach out to straighten the plaque.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后再有人问，我就直接叫他来找你。
lines.en: If anyone asks again, I'll just send them to you.

blocks.label_en: If the Plaque Has Been Removed

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哪天还想接这些客人，就把牌子摆出来。我说过的话算数，不用每回再问我。
lines.en: If you want to take those customers again someday, put the plaque back out. My word stands. You don't have to ask me every time.

scenes.title_en: The Line She Taught Herself

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 下回你跟她见面，别老问工作顺不顺。她有时候也想让你注意到她新换的发饰。
lines.en: Next time you see her, don't keep asking whether work's going well. Sometimes she wants you to notice her new hair ornament.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你今天也换了。
lines.en: You changed yours today too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她下意识抬手碰了碰发夹，动作比嘴快了一步。*
lines.en: *Without thinking, she raises a hand to her hair clip. Her hand moves faster than her mouth.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你、你怎么看得这么仔细？
lines.en: ...You—why are you looking so closely?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你教的。看人，别光看柜台。
lines.en: You taught me. Look at the person, not just the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我是让你看她！
lines.en: I meant look at her!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我知道。所以跟你说一声，这招有用。
lines.en: I know. So I'm telling you—the trick works.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她张了张嘴，没接上话。*
lines.en: *She opens her mouth, but nothing comes out.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……谢谢。
lines.en: ...Thank you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把发夹摘下来看了看，又别了回去。*
lines.en: *She takes the clip out, looks at it, and puts it back.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那是我送她的！你这眼力，到底是好还是不好？
lines.en: ...I gave her that one! Is your eye for detail good or bad?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今晚还要赶下一场？
lines.en: Do you have to rush to another appointment tonight?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不赶。本来想去看新到的裙子，走到半路，又绕到这儿来了。
lines.en: No rush. I meant to go see the new dresses, but halfway there I came around to this place instead.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怎么不去了？
lines.en: Why didn't you go?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天也能看。……你别每句都追着问！
lines.en: I can look tomorrow. ...Don't question every single thing I say!

choices.label_zh: 很适合你。
choices.label_en: It suits you.
choices.description_zh: 两项只影响她的回应，均不确立恋爱，不锁后续双恋；真正分流在本线第14章。
choices.description_en: Both options only affect her response. Neither establishes romance or locks the later dual romance; the actual branching happens in Chapter 14.

choices.label_zh: 埃莉诺好像也有一枚差不多的。
choices.label_en: I think Eleanor has one just like it.
choices.description_zh: 两项只影响她的回应，均不确立恋爱，不锁后续双恋；真正分流在本线第14章。
choices.description_en: Both options only affect her response. Neither establishes romance or locks the later dual romance; the actual branching happens in Chapter 14.

scenes.title_en: Time Set Aside

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下周有两天，我能早点下来。我写下来了。
lines.en: There are two days next week when I can come down early. I wrote them down.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这么正式？
lines.en: So formal?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面事情一多，谁都说“就耽误你一会儿”。我不提前留出来，自己的事就总得往后放。
lines.en: When things get busy upstairs, everyone says 'this will only take a moment.' If I don't set time aside in advance, my own plans always get pushed back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那两天是你的事，还是我的事？
lines.en: Those two days—are they for your things or mine?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我们的。
lines.en: ...Ours.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把纸推到你手边，又不放心地补了一句。*
lines.en: *She pushes the paper toward you, then adds one more thing, as if uneasy.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你也记着。
lines.en: Write it down too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 记住了。
lines.en: I've got it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟莉迪亚说了，改天好好请她吃顿饭。上回她跑得比谁都快。
lines.en: I told Lydia we should treat her to a proper meal one of these days. Last time she ran off faster than anyone.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回让她别跑。
lines.en: Tell her not to run this time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯，我跟她说。……不过她最近有点怪。
lines.en: Mm, I'll tell her. ...Though she's been a little strange lately.

scenes.title_en: She's Suddenly Very Busy

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚最近来过吗？
lines.en: Has Lydia been by lately?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 前几天来过。后来就没了。
lines.en: She came a few days ago. Then nothing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟我说忙。我提起她一直想去的那家新店，她连在哪儿都没问，就说已经约了别人。
lines.en: She told me she's busy. I brought up that new shop she's been wanting to visit. She didn't even ask where it was—just said she'd already made plans with someone else.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 可能真有约。
lines.en: Maybe she really did.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她那个人，真不想出门的时候，会嫌鞋磨脚、嫌裙子不合身。从来不会连我说的地方都没听清，就说没空。
lines.en: When she really doesn't want to go out, she complains her shoes rub or her dress doesn't fit. She'd never say she's busy without even hearing where I meant.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她看了一眼柜台边那把椅子。*
lines.en: *She glances at the chair by the counter.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在你这儿，会聊她自己的事吗？
lines.en: Does she talk about her own things when she's here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 会。
lines.en: She does.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……以前她跟我说起你，全是“他该这样”“你该那样”。最近一个字都不提了。
lines.en: ...Before, whenever she talked about you, it was all 'he should do this' and 'you should do that.' Lately she doesn't say a word.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你想问什么？
lines.en: What do you want to ask?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我还没想好。想好了再问。
lines.en: I haven't decided. I'll ask when I have.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有，你别因为我问了这一句，就突然装作不认识她。……那样更难看。
lines.en: And don't suddenly pretend you don't know her just because I asked. ...That would look even worse.

scenes.title_en: This Time I Really Won't Help

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后你想约她，直接问她就行。我最近……事情多。
lines.en: From now on, if you want to ask her out, just ask her. I've been... busy lately.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我们已经直接说了。
lines.en: We've already talked directly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就好。我这件事算办完了。
lines.en: Good. Then my job here is done.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以以后不来了？
lines.en: So you won't come anymore?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又不是非得天天往这儿绕。
lines.en: It's not like I have to come around here every day.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上回你为了绕过来，连想看的裙子都没去看。
lines.en: Last time you came around here, you didn't even go see the dress you wanted.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……后来有别的安排。
lines.en: ...I had other plans later.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不想说可以不说。别编一场约会给我听。
lines.en: If you don't want to talk about it, you don't have to. Don't invent an appointment for me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她不再翻包了，两只手慢慢落到膝盖上。*
lines.en: *She stops rummaging in her bag. Her hands slowly come to rest on her knees.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我以为事情办成了，我会很高兴。
lines.en: I thought I'd be happy once it worked out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不高兴？
lines.en: You're not?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 高兴！替她高兴，也替你高兴。
lines.en: I am! Happy for her, and happy for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就是……她跟我说你们见了面，我第一个想的，是你们聊了什么。她没提到我，我又气自己，怎么连这个都要在意。
lines.en: It's just... when she told me you'd met up, the first thing I thought about was what you talked about. She didn't mention me, and then I was angry at myself for caring about that at all.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 莉迪亚。
lines.en: Lydia.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你别安慰我。你一认真看着我，我就更说不下去了。
lines.en: Don't comfort me. When you look at me seriously, I can't finish a sentence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她站了起来，这回没拿玩笑收场。*
lines.en: *She stands up. This time she doesn't end it with a joke.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 让我自己想想。今天就到这儿吧。
lines.en: Let me think on my own. That's enough for today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人的事照常。已经说好的，我都会交代清楚。
lines.en: The customer business stays as usual. Whatever's already arranged, I'll make clear.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我问的不是客人。
lines.en: I'm not asking about customers.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我知道。
lines.en: ...I know.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你想来就来。不用替谁带话，也不用带生意。
lines.en: Come whenever you want. You don't need to carry messages for anyone, or bring business.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她的手已经搭上了门，停了一下。*
lines.en: *Her hand is already on the door. She pauses.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这么说，我就更不知道该怎么走了。
lines.en: When you say that, I have even less idea how to leave.

scenes.title_zh: 不再借她的名义来找你
scenes.title_en: I Won't Come in Her Name Anymore

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这回我不说路过了。
lines.en: I won't say I was passing by this time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。
lines.en: All right.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一开始，我真的只是想让她过得好一点。后来你问我吃没吃饭，还记得我那枚胸针……我就开始盼着来这儿了。
lines.en: At first, I really just wanted her to be a little better off. Then you asked whether I'd eaten, and you remembered my brooch... and I started looking forward to coming here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道你们在一起。正因为知道，我才不能再装作每回都是替她跑腿。
lines.en: I know you're together. And because I know, I can't keep pretending every visit is just me running errands for her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你想听我怎么说？
lines.en: What do you want me to say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真话。别跟我说什么谁都舍不得，然后让我自己猜后面是什么意思。
lines.en: The truth. Don't tell me you can't bear to hurt anyone and then leave me to guess what that means.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你知道这可不是多摆一把椅子那么简单。
lines.en: ...You know this isn't as simple as setting out one more chair.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道。你不用替我说，也不用替她答应。
lines.en: I know. You don't need to speak for me, and you don't need to answer for her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真是的……这回居然轮到我等你把话说清楚。
lines.en: Honestly... Now it's my turn to wait for you to say it clearly.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我会说清楚。在那之前，不让你偷偷摸摸地等。
lines.en: I will say it clearly. Until then, I won't make you wait in secret.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。……我也会自己去找她。
lines.en: Mm. ...I'll go find her myself too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……嗯。这样就清楚了。
lines.en: ...Mm. That's clear, then.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 对不起。
lines.en: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不喜欢我，用不着道歉。让我难受几天就好，别急着把我逗笑。
lines.en: You don't have to apologize for not liking me. Just let me feel bad for a few days. Don't rush to cheer me up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。
lines.en: All right.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后有正经生意，照样能谈。只是我不会再替你们安排约会了。
lines.en: If there's real business later, we can still talk. I just won't arrange dates for you two anymore.

choices.label_zh: 我也喜欢你。可我跟她在一起，不会背着她答应你什么。这件事，我会亲口告诉她。
choices.label_en: I like you too. But I'm with her, and I won't promise you anything behind her back. I'll tell her this myself.
choices.description_zh: 开启三人关系的明确讨论；尚未确立双恋，三人将分别表达意愿。
choices.description_en: Open the explicit three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

choices.label_zh: 我不会背着她答应你。我们一起去跟她说。
choices.label_en: I won't promise behind her back. Let's tell her together.
choices.description_zh: 继续三人讨论；尚未提交双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

scenes.title_en: She Wants to Hear It From You

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 莉迪亚昨天来过。她说她喜欢我。
lines.en: Lydia came by yesterday. She told me she likes me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *埃莉诺正要坐下，手里的包停在了半空。*
lines.en: *Eleanor is about to sit. The bag in her hand stops in midair.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……然后呢？
lines.en: ...And then?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢她。这件事，得我自己来告诉你。
lines.en: I like her too. This is something I had to tell you myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: You—

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把包往柜台上一放，声音比平时高了一截。*
lines.en: *She sets the bag down on the counter. Her voice is louder than usual.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你还真敢当着我的面说！
lines.en: You really dare say it to my face!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不当面说，你就得从别人嘴里听到。那样更糟。
lines.en: If I didn't say it to your face, you'd hear it from someone else. That would be worse.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以我还得谢谢你？
lines.en: So I should thank you?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不用。你可以生气。
lines.en: No. You're allowed to be angry.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我当然生气！……我早就觉得不对劲了。她不来，你也不提。我还以为是我自己多心。
lines.en: Of course I'm angry! ...I've felt something was off for a while. She didn't come, and you didn't mention her. I thought I was imagining things.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你没多心。这事怪我。
lines.en: You weren't imagining it. This is on me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 当然怪你！
lines.en: Of course it's on you!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她瞪着你，眼眶有点红，就是不肯低头。*
lines.en: *She glares at you, her eyes a little red, refusing to look down.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你现在想怎么样？跟我分开？
lines.en: So what do you want now? To break up with me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不分开。我还想跟你在一起。我没背着你跟她怎么样，以后也不会。
lines.en: No. I still want to be with you. I didn't do anything with her behind your back, and I won't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你倒是坦白。
lines.en: ...You're honest, at least.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她呢？她怎么说？
lines.en: And her? What did she say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说会自己去找你。
lines.en: She said she'd come find you herself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她找我？
lines.en: She'll find me?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *埃莉诺冷笑了一声，可那声笑没撑多久。*
lines.en: *Eleanor gives a cold laugh, but it doesn't last long.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前两天我还在想，她要是再也不来了，是不是就能当作什么都没发生。
lines.en: A couple of days ago I was thinking that if she never came again, maybe I could pretend none of this had happened.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后来呢？
lines.en: And then?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后来我自己想去找她。想问她到底在躲什么……又怕她真说出来。
lines.en: Then I wanted to go find her myself. I wanted to ask what she was hiding from... and I was afraid she'd actually tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我认识她十几年了。我家出事以后，上面那些人一个个都不见了，就她还隔三差五往下跑。
lines.en: I've known her for over ten years. After my family's trouble, everyone upstairs disappeared one by one. She's the only one who kept coming down every few days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她现在要是因为我躲起来，以后连这扇门都不敢进……我不要。
lines.en: If she hides because of me now and doesn't even dare come through that door again... I don't want that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你想怎么做？
lines.en: Then what do you want to do?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先让我跟她谈。我有话要问她，你替不了。
lines.en: Let me talk to her first. I have questions for her that you can't answer for me.

blocks.label_en: One: Wait for Them to Talk

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天你别突然不找我。别以为我生气了，你就该躲远点。
lines.en: Don't suddenly stop coming to see me these next few days. Don't think that because I'm angry, you should stay away.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天照常开门。你来，就能见到我。
lines.en: I'll open as usual tomorrow. If you come, you'll see me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: ...Hmph.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *你把她常用的那只杯子推过去。她瞪了它一会儿，还是端了起来。*
lines.en: *You push the cup she always uses toward her. She glares at it for a moment, then picks it up anyway.*

choices.label_zh: 好。等你们谈完。你想问我什么，我都答。
choices.label_en: All right. After you two talk. Whatever you want to ask me, I'll answer.
choices.description_zh: 继续共同关系讨论，尚未登记双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the joint discussion; the relationship is not registered yet.

choices.label_zh: 我需要一点时间，但我不会退出去。
choices.label_en: I need a little time, but I'm not backing out.
choices.description_zh: 保持三人讨论，照常见面。
choices.description_en: Keep the discussion going and keep meeting as usual.

scenes.title_zh: 你教我的话，自己也听一遍
scenes.title_en: Listen to the Line You Taught Me

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *莉迪亚进门时，眼睛还有点肿，妆却补得一丝不乱。*
lines.en: *When Lydia comes in, her eyes are still a little puffy, but her makeup has been redone without a flaw.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我去找她了。……不对，是她先来找的我。
lines.en: I went to find her. ...No, she came to find me first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她怎么说？
lines.en: What did she say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她一进门就问我：“你不是说过，喜欢一个人，就别总让他猜吗？”
lines.en: The moment she walked in, she asked me: 'Didn't you say that if you like someone, you shouldn't keep making them guess?'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是我以前教她的话！她拿来堵我的嘴。
lines.en: That's what I taught her before! She used it to shut me up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么答的？
lines.en: How did you answer?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说那是说她。她说：“轮到你，就不算数了？”
lines.en: I said that was about her. She said: 'So it doesn't count when it's your turn?'

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把一缕发尾绕在指上，又一点点松开。*
lines.en: *She winds a strand of hair around her finger, then slowly lets it go.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说，她要是不想再看见我，我以后就不……话还没说完，她就打断我了。
lines.en: I said if she didn't want to see me anymore, then I'd... Before I finished, she cut me off.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说什么？
lines.en: Saying what?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: “你看，又替我把话答了。”
lines.en: 'See? You're answering for me again.'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……以前看你们俩死活不肯开口，我急得恨不得替你们说。轮到我自己，连第一句该从哪儿说起都不知道。
lines.en: ...Before, watching you two refuse to open your mouths, I was so anxious I wanted to say it for you. When it was my turn, I didn't even know where to start.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后来呢？
lines.en: And then?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 后来她问我，到底想要什么。
lines.en: Then she asked me what I actually wanted.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说，我想见你。不是把她送到门口，然后自己站在外面等。
lines.en: I said I want to see you. Not drop her at the door and then stand outside waiting by myself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说……她也想。
lines.en: She said... she wants that too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她还说，她不会一下子就不介意，也不会每回都把约好的晚上让给我。
lines.en: She also said she won't stop minding all at once, and she won't give up our agreed evenings for me every time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么说？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说用不着她让。我的时间我自己争，不抢她的。
lines.en: I said she doesn't need to give anything up. I'll fight for my own time. I won't take hers.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 然后我们俩都哭了。……她不承认的，你别问她。
lines.en: Then we both cried. ...She won't admit it, so don't ask her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。
lines.en: All right.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说明天跟我一起来。先说好，这可不是我替你把事情办妥了。
lines.en: She said she'll come with me tomorrow. Just so we're clear, this isn't me smoothing everything out for you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没这么想。
lines.en: I didn't think that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有一句，我得自己说。我想跟你在一起，不是因为只有这样才能接着见到她。
lines.en: There's one more thing I need to say myself. I want to be with you—not just because it's the only way I can keep seeing her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我听见了。
lines.en: I heard you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那明天就轮到你了。想清楚再说，别到时候只会一句“都行”。
lines.en: Then tomorrow it's your turn. Think it through before you speak. Don't just say 'whatever works' when the time comes.

scenes.title_en: All Three of Us, Saying Everything

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *两个人一起进门。埃莉诺没有站在莉迪亚身后，莉迪亚也没抢着开口。*
lines.en: *The two of them come in together. Eleanor doesn't stand behind Lydia, and Lydia doesn't rush to speak first.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐吧。今天先说我们的事。
lines.en: Sit down. Today we talk about us first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟你说我哭了，是吧？
lines.en: She told you I cried, didn't she?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我没哭。是她哭得太厉害，我递手帕的时候不小心沾到了。
lines.en: I didn't cry. She was crying so hard that I got some on me when I handed her a handkerchief.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你们俩现在撒谎的样子，倒是越来越像。
lines.en: ...You two are starting to look more and more alike when you lie.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少废话。
lines.en: Enough.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *埃莉诺清了清嗓子，转向你。*
lines.en: *Eleanor clears her throat and turns to you.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我先说。我愿意试试，三个人一起。但我有条件。
lines.en: I'll go first. I'm willing to try—the three of us together. But I have conditions.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说。
lines.en: Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第一，我吃醋了就会说。你不许拿“当初是你自己答应的”来堵我。
lines.en: First, when I'm jealous, I'll say so. You're not allowed to shut me up with 'you agreed to this in the first place.'

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不会。你不高兴就告诉我。
lines.en: I won't. If you're unhappy, tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第二，约好了是谁的时间，就是谁的。临时要改，先跟那个人说清楚。
lines.en: Second, when time is set aside for someone, it belongs to that person. If plans change at the last minute, tell that person first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这条我也要。我可不是你们俩想起来才叫一声的人。
lines.en: I want that rule too. I'm not someone you two call over only when you happen to remember me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。我会分别留时间，也会有三个人一起的时候。要改约，先打招呼。
lines.en: All right. I'll set aside time with each of you, and there'll be times for all three of us. If plans change, I'll say so first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第三，我们俩自己也会出去。不是每回都得带上你。
lines.en: Third, the two of us will go out on our own too. We don't have to bring you every time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你们有自己的日子。
lines.en: You have your own time together.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我也加一条——你别为了摆出一副照顾两个人的样子，最后连自己在想什么都不说。
lines.en: Then I'll add one—don't put on a show of taking care of both of us and end up never saying what you're actually thinking.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那我现在就说。我想跟你们两个在一起。不是先答应一个，让另一个等着。
lines.en: Then I'll say it now. I want to be with both of you. Not promise one and leave the other waiting.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我愿意。……以后难听的话，你也不许躲。
lines.en: I'm willing. ...And don't dodge the ugly things I'll say from now on.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也愿意。这回是我自己答应的，没替谁传话。
lines.en: I'm willing too. This time I'm answering for myself, not passing on someone else's words.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *你把手放在桌上。埃莉诺先握了上来；莉迪亚看了她一眼，才把手放到你的另一边。*
lines.en: *You place your hand on the table. Eleanor takes it first. Lydia glances at her, then puts her hand on your other side.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来只是来帮个小忙的。
lines.en: I only came to help out a little.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 帮得可真够彻底。
lines.en: You certainly helped thoroughly.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在想收介绍费了？
lines.en: Do you want a referral fee now?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 想收一个吻。……不过别当着整家店的面。
lines.en: I'd like a kiss as payment. ...But not in front of the whole shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就不能慢一点？
lines.en: Can't you slow down?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个嘛，以后你可以教我。
lines.en: Well, you can teach me that later.

choices.label_zh: 如果你们也都愿意，那从今天起，我们三个人认真走下去。
choices.label_en: If you're both willing too, then starting today, let's be serious about this—all three of us.
choices.description_zh: 双方明确同意后提交双恋；不收取任何费用。
choices.description_en: Commit the dual relationship after both explicit agreements; no fee.

scenes.title_en: She Finally Doesn't Need an Excuse

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天没替她带话。
lines.en: No messages from her today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 也不是路过？
lines.en: And you're not just passing by?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 专门来的。这样够清楚了吧？
lines.en: I came specifically to see you. Is that clear enough?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她走到柜台边，没急着坐下。还是那枚玫瑰色的发夹，这回她大大方方地看着你，等你认出来。*
lines.en: *She walks to the counter but doesn't hurry to sit. She's wearing the same rose-colored hair clip. This time she looks at you openly, waiting for you to notice.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 够清楚了。
lines.en: Clear enough.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想过好多回，要是真能这样进门，第一句该说什么。
lines.en: I've thought many times about what I'd say first if I could really walk in like this.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 结果呢？
lines.en: And the result?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 结果第一句还是跟她有关。这习惯真难改。
lines.en: The first thing out of my mouth was still about her. That habit is hard to break.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那第二句留给你自己。
lines.en: Then save the second line for yourself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我想你了。
lines.en: ...I missed you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她今天穿了一条玫瑰色的约会裙，奶油白的短披肩搭在臂弯里。发夹还是那一枚，卷发却仔细打理过。*
lines.en: *Today she's wearing a rose-colored date dress, with a cream-white short shawl draped over her arm. The hair clip is the same one, but her curls have been carefully styled.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天要去哪儿？
lines.en: Where are we going today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 已经到了。
lines.en: We're already here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 专门为这儿挑的？
lines.en: Did you pick it just for this place?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。先挑了一条，觉得太像去见长辈，又换了这条。出门前还想问问埃莉诺，后来想起来，这回该我自己拿主意。
lines.en: Mm. I picked one first, then thought it looked too much like meeting a relative, so I changed to this one. Before I left, I almost asked Eleanor, then remembered this time I should decide for myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿得很好。
lines.en: Good choice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她明明就在等这句话，听到了，却先低下头笑了。*
lines.en: *She was clearly waiting for that. When she hears it, she lowers her head and smiles first.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前教你夸她的时候，没觉得一句话这么难接。
lines.en: When I was teaching you to compliment her, I never thought one line could be so hard to receive.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在不用教了。
lines.en: You don't need to teach me now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那你多看一会儿。又不是只给你看进门那一眼。
lines.en: ...Then look a little longer. It's not just for that first moment in the doorway.

blocks.label_en: Replacement Middle Section Without the New Portrait

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她认真理过头发，看着你，等你先开口。*
lines.en: *She carefully smooths her hair and looks at you, waiting for you to speak first.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 出门前照了好一会儿镜子。想问埃莉诺，又觉得这回该我自己拿主意。
lines.en: I stood in front of the mirror for a while before leaving. I wanted to ask Eleanor, then thought this time I should decide for myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看见了。今天很好看。
lines.en: I see. You look beautiful today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我还以为得我提醒你呢。
lines.en: ...I thought I'd have to remind you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她靠了过来，先扶着你的肩，过了一会儿才放松下来。你吻了吻她，这回她没急着拿一句玩笑把你推开。*
lines.en: *She leans in, resting a hand on your shoulder first, and only relaxes after a moment. You kiss her, and this time she doesn't rush to push you away with a joke.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……原来真到了这时候，我也没那么会说话。
lines.en: ...So when it actually happens, I'm not that good with words after all.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不用一直说。
lines.en: You don't have to keep talking.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把椅子挪近了些。你握住她的手，她就没再挪开。*
lines.en: *She moves her chair closer. You take her hand, and she doesn't pull it away.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那今天我不替别人找话题了。我把我自己的事，从头讲给你听。
lines.en: Then today I won't find conversation topics for anyone else. I'll tell you my own story from the beginning.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天你跟她约好了，我知道。今天你别老看时间，弄得好像我随时又要先走。
lines.en: I know you have plans with her tomorrow. Don't keep checking the time today. It makes it look like I'm about to rush off again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天的时间是你的。
lines.en: Today's time is yours.

choices.label_zh: 过来，让我抱一会儿。
choices.label_en: Come here. Let me hold you for a while.

choices.label_zh: 坐近一点，今天慢慢聊。
choices.label_en: Sit closer. Let's take our time talking today.

scenes.title_en: She Didn't Give Up Her Place

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天是我们约好的。
lines.en: Today is the day we agreed on.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我记得。
lines.en: I remember.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我知道你记得。就是想听你说一遍。
lines.en: I know you remember. I just wanted to hear you say it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她在你身边坐下，把包往旁边一放。*
lines.en: *She sits down beside you and sets her bag to one side.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 工作怎么样？
lines.en: How's work?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 顺。上面的人都知道了，我哪天要早走，别拿临时的活来塞我。
lines.en: Fine. Everyone upstairs knows now. On days I leave early, they shouldn't try to dump last-minute work on me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你跟他们说是来见我？
lines.en: Did you tell them you're coming to see me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 说了。我又不是偷偷摸摸来的。
lines.en: I did. I'm not sneaking around.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她安静了一会儿。*
lines.en: *She's quiet for a moment.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……她昨天来过了吧？
lines.en: ...She came by yesterday, didn't she?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 来过。
lines.en: She did.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 待了多久？
lines.en: How long did she stay?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你想知道？
lines.en: Do you want to know?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不想！……我就是随口一问。
lines.en: No! ...I was just asking.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你可以问。不用装作不在乎。
lines.en: You can ask. You don't have to pretend not to care.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你也别一见我，就把跟她说过的话全交代一遍。听得我像个来查账的。
lines.en: Then don't give me a full account of everything you said to her the moment you see me. It makes me feel like I'm here to audit the books.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。今天只听你的。
lines.en: All right. Today is only about you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天就想说一件事——我从上面回来，第一个想见的，还是你。
lines.en: There's only one thing I want to say today—when I come back from upstairs, the first person I want to see is still you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她靠在你肩上，握住了你的手。*
lines.en: *She leans on your shoulder and takes your hand.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别以为多了一个人，我就会少要一点。
lines.en: Don't think that because there's one more person, I'll ask for less.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没打算让你少要。
lines.en: I wasn't planning to ask you to.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……那就好。
lines.en: ...Good.

scenes.title_zh: 今天不用替我们腾地方
scenes.title_en: You Don't Have to Make Room for Us Today

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *埃莉诺先进门，手里拎着个纸袋。莉迪亚跟在后面，两只手护着一包用纸裹好的点心，发尾蹭到了脸上也腾不出手去拨。*
lines.en: *Eleanor comes in first, carrying a paper bag. Lydia follows, both hands guarding a package of pastries wrapped in paper. A strand of hair brushes her face, but she has no free hand to push it back.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天你别再说“随便吃点”。
lines.en: Don't say 'let's just eat something' today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你们俩商量好的？
lines.en: Did you two plan this?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不商量好，总有人忙到最后，拿一口冷饭当晚饭。
lines.en: If we didn't plan it, someone would end up too busy and call a bite of cold rice dinner.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说的是你，也是她自己。
lines.en: She means you, and herself too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你现在连我的话都替我补全了？
lines.en: Now you're finishing my sentences for me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你以前补得比我多。
lines.en: You used to finish mine more than I do yours.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *桌上摆了三只杯子。埃莉诺给你夹了点菜。莉迪亚笑着看你们俩，手习惯性地伸向椅边的小包。*
lines.en: *Three cups are set on the table. Eleanor puts some food on your plate. Lydia watches the two of you with a smile, her hand moving by habit toward the small bag beside her chair.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就先——
lines.en: Then I'll just—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下。
lines.en: Sit down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把第三只杯子推回到莉迪亚面前。*
lines.en: *She pushes the third cup back in front of Lydia.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天不用替我们腾地方。
lines.en: You don't have to make room for us today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你那份也留着呢。
lines.en: There's a place for you too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *莉迪亚的手停住了。过了一会儿，她把包放回椅边。*
lines.en: *Lydia's hand stops. After a moment, she puts the bag back beside her chair.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又没说要走。只是……上回坐在这儿，到了这个时候，就该我找借口了。
lines.en: I didn't say I was leaving. It's just... last time I sat here, when it got to this point, it was my turn to find an excuse.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回不用找。
lines.en: You don't need to this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那我不走了。点心还没吃呢。
lines.en: ...Then I won't go. We haven't had the pastries yet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她拆开点心，先递给埃莉诺一块，再递给你一块，最后给自己挑了奶油最多的那块。*
lines.en: *She opens the pastries, hands one to Eleanor, then one to you, and finally picks the one with the most cream for herself.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你不是说，今天是专门给我们买的？
lines.en: Didn't you say you bought these specially for us today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是以前的说法。今天我也想吃。
lines.en: That was the old way of saying it. Today I want some too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这句说得倒挺直接。
lines.en: That was pretty direct.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来就会直说。只有喜欢你这件事，练得久了一点。
lines.en: I've always been direct. I just needed a little longer to practice saying I like you.

blocks.label_en: After Dinner, If the Plaque Is Still in the Showcase

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *你起身去收柜台。莉迪亚顺着你的目光望向橱窗，那块铭牌映着屋里的灯。*
lines.en: *You get up to tidy the counter. Lydia follows your gaze to the showcase, where the recommendation plaque catches the light from the room.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 牌子拿来那天，你说生意做成了，吃饭的地方由你挑。
lines.en: The day you brought the plaque, you said once the business worked out, you'd pick where we eat.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 挑好了。
lines.en: I've picked.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 挑了这么久，还是这儿？
lines.en: You took this long to pick, and it's still here?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这儿有我想见的人。两个都在。
lines.en: The people I want to see are here. Both of them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那以后不用每回带个客人来换一顿饭了。
lines.en: Then you don't have to bring a customer every time to earn a meal.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 早就不带了。你没发现我最近来得越来越理直气壮？
lines.en: I stopped a while ago. Haven't you noticed I've been coming in more and more like I belong here?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 发现了。椅子也越挪越近。
lines.en: I've noticed. Your chair keeps getting closer too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还好意思说我？
lines.en: And you have the nerve to say that about me?

lines.speaker: Narrator
