lines.text: *埃莉诺没把椅子挪回去。你坐下的时候，两个人都往旁边让了让，中间留的是你的位置。*
lines.en: *Eleanor doesn't move her chair back. When you sit down, both of them shift aside, leaving the middle place for you.*

blocks.label_en: Plaque Not Displayed or Not Collected

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天没有介绍来的客人，也没替谁带话。
lines.en: No customers came through a recommendation today, and I didn't bring messages for anyone.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道。你的饭就在这儿。
lines.en: I know. Your meal is right here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天也别一进门就问有什么事。
lines.en: And tomorrow, don't ask what I need the moment I walk in.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就直接问，你想不想见我。
lines.en: Then I'll just ask directly—do you want to see me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……行。这句我记住了。
lines.en: ...All right. I'll remember that one.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺回到了上层区。那里有她的工作、她熟悉的街道，也有许多得她自己拿主意的事。她没有为了谁放弃机会，也没有因为回去了，就把这家当铺留在过去。
lines.en: Eleanor returned to the Upper Levels. Her work is there, along with the streets she knows and many decisions she has to make for herself. She didn't give up her chance for anyone's sake, and going back didn't mean leaving this pawnshop in the past.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚还是喜欢新裙子和漂亮发饰，还是爱听朋友讲恋爱的事，也还是忍不住给人出主意——被埃莉诺瞪一眼，就笑着改口。只是现在，她进门时不用再先解释，自己替谁带了什么话。
lines.en: Lydia still loves new dresses and pretty hair ornaments. She still loves hearing her friends talk about romance, and she still can't help giving advice—though one glare from Eleanor makes her laugh and change her tune. Only now, when she comes in, she doesn't have to explain whose message she's carrying first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你还在下层区开店。有时候来的是一个人，有时候是两个。她们会抢一把椅子，会在你算账算到一半时把账本合上，也会在你真忙得脱不开身时，自己聊到一边去。
lines.en: You're still running your shop in the Lower Levels. Sometimes one of them comes; sometimes both. They'll fight over the same chair, close your ledger halfway through your accounts, and wander off to talk among themselves when you're truly too busy to step away.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 在上面，她们是别人眼里得体的大小姐。到了这儿，用不着。
lines.en: Upstairs, they're proper young ladies in everyone else's eyes. Down here, they don't have to be.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 桌上摆着三只杯子。今天没有人先走。
lines.en: Three cups sit on the table. Today, no one leaves first.

blocks.label_zh: 铭牌带来实际业务时追加
blocks.label_en: Added If the Plaque Has Brought Actual Business

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 橱窗里的名字，会让路过的人停下来看一眼。可真进了门，他们问的是东西，谈的是价钱。到了饭桌边，莉迪亚不用再替那块牌子说话，埃莉诺也不用再替她解释。
lines.en: The name in the showcase makes passersby stop and look. But once they come inside, they ask about goods and talk about prices. At the dinner table, Lydia no longer has to speak for the plaque, and Eleanor no longer has to explain for her.

scenes.title_zh: 已经在一起的人，也会需要帮忙
scenes.title_en: People Already Together Can Still Use a Hand

blocks.label_zh: 若埃莉诺已有上层工作
blocks.label_en: If Eleanor Already Has Upper-Level Work

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她最近上上下下两头跑，见了我就说你忙。你们俩到底有没有给自己留过一个晚上？
lines.en: She's been running between the Upper and Lower Levels lately, and every time I see her, she says you're busy. Have you two actually set aside a single evening for yourselves?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 留过。你是想问，有没有去你说的那家？
lines.en: We have. You're asking whether we went to that place you mentioned?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……也想问。她回来就一句“挺好”，我哪知道你们吃了什么！
lines.en: ...I wanted to ask that too. She comes back with just 'it was nice,' and how would I know what you ate!

blocks.label_en: If She Doesn't Have Upper-Level Work Yet

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她忙她的，你忙你的店。你们俩每回见面，是不是又先问今天卖了多少？
lines.en: She's busy with her work, you're busy with the shop. Every time you meet, do you start by asking how much you sold today?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 也聊别的。
lines.en: We talk about other things too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道，她就是不肯告诉我。要不我帮你们想个地方，好好坐一会儿？
lines.en: I know. She just won't tell me. Why don't I help you think of a place where you can sit down properly for a while?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你打算怎么帮？
lines.en: How do you plan to help?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 放心，我不替你们把日子定死。我问她哪天有空，你也说。到时候你自己去约她，别让我来回传话。
lines.en: Relax, I won't lock down your schedule for you. I'll ask when she's free, and you tell me your days too. Then you ask her out yourself. Don't make me run back and forth with messages.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行。还有件事——我看过你店里的东西了。上面有些人，一听是下层区，连问都不问。
lines.en: Good. There's something else—I've looked at what you have in the shop. Some people upstairs hear 'Lower Level' and don't even ask.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你以前也这样？
lines.en: Were you like that before?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……以前！你可以记着，但先让我把话说完。
lines.en: ...Before! You can remember that, but let me finish first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说。
lines.en: Go on.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想介绍几个人过来。你先让我看看有什么，别让我带错人。
lines.en: I want to send a few people your way. Let me see what you have first, so I don't bring the wrong ones.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好吧，我少管一桩。哪天你真把她约出去了，好歹告诉我一声，省得我还替你们干着急。
lines.en: Fine, one less thing for me to meddle in. If you do take her out someday, at least tell me, so I don't keep worrying for you two.

blocks.label_zh: 本线第7章旧档替代开场

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说那顿饭挺好。这回总算多说了一句——说你还记得她以前不爱吃什么。
lines.en: She said the meal was nice. She finally added one more thing this time—that you remembered what she never liked to eat.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你走得太快了。
lines.en: You left too quickly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我要是留下，你们又得问我今天去哪儿了。那顿本来就是给你们约的。
lines.en: If I'd stayed, you two would've asked where I was going. That meal was arranged for you two in the first place.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你也可以说说你自己的事。
lines.en: You could talk about your own things too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那枚胸针，后来我买了。只按东西本身跟他谈，没再听什么名人的故事。
lines.en: ...I ended up buying that brooch. I negotiated on the piece itself and didn't listen to any more stories about famous people.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 喜欢吗？
lines.en: Do you like it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 喜欢。已经配过两条裙子了。
lines.en: I do. I've already worn it with two dresses.

blocks.label_en: Legacy Save With Existing Work Fact

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面的时间排开了。哪天下来，我提前告诉你。
lines.en: My schedule upstairs is sorted out. I'll tell you in advance which day I'm coming down.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那天我留着。
lines.en: I'll keep that day open.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 是留给我的。可不是留着等莉迪亚来替我打听。
lines.en: Keep it for me. Not for waiting around while Lydia comes to ask questions on my behalf.

choices.label_zh: 好。你出主意，我自己约她。
choices.label_en: All right. You come up with ideas, and I'll ask her myself.
choices.description_zh: 进入旧档撮合与荐店内容；不重播原告白，不收费。
choices.description_en: Enter the legacy-save matchmaking and recommendation content. The original confession is not replayed, and no fee is charged.

choices.label_zh: 我们自己安排。以后来店里，照常坐。
choices.label_en: We'll arrange it ourselves. When you come to the shop, sit down as usual.
choices.description_zh: 拒绝本扩展，不反复推销，保留原普通恋爱后续。
choices.description_en: Decline this expansion. It will not be pushed again, and the original ordinary romance continues.

scenes.title_zh: 暂缓、拒绝与讨论后收回提议
scenes.title_en: Deferral, Refusal, and Withdrawing the Proposal

blocks.label_en: Confirming Lovers After the Confession Was Deferred

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我想清楚了。这回不让你再等一句“以后”。
lines.en: I've thought it through. This time I won't make you wait for another 'someday.'

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就现在说。
lines.en: Then say it now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我喜欢你。想跟你认真在一起。
lines.en: I like you. I want to be with you seriously.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……嗯。下回这种话，直接来找我说。
lines.en: ...Mm. Next time you have something like that to say, come tell me directly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她跟我说了，你们以后还是朋友。
lines.en: She told me you two will stay friends.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就不瞎琢磨了。客人的事照常，别因为这个，连见面都弄得尴尬。
lines.en: Then I'll stop imagining things. Customer business stays as usual. Don't let this make even seeing each other awkward.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不会。
lines.en: It won't.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好。……我也该学学，别老替别人写结局。
lines.en: Good. ...I should learn not to keep writing endings for other people.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我想清楚了。两段感情，我顾不过来。我还是只跟埃莉诺在一起。
lines.en: I've thought it through. I can't handle two relationships. I'm staying with Eleanor only.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你之前说，你也喜欢我。
lines.en: You said before that you liked me too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那是真的。可我给不了你那个承诺。让你走到这一步，是我对不起你。
lines.en: That was true. But I can't give you that promise. I'm sorry for letting you get this far.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……好。别再给我留一句“以后也许”，让我接着等。
lines.en: ...All right. Don't leave me another 'maybe someday' to keep waiting on.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不会。
lines.en: I won't.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人那边我会交代。至于我……让我过几天再来。你们也别急着假装什么都没发生过。
lines.en: I'll explain things to the customers. As for me... let me come back in a few days. And don't rush to pretend none of this happened.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 跟她说了？
lines.en: Did you tell her?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说了。是我自己的决定，没推到你身上。
lines.en: I did. It was my decision. I didn't put it on you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……嗯。以后也别装作她从来没认真说过。
lines.en: ...Mm. And don't act like she never said it seriously.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我记得。
lines.en: I remember.

scenes.title_zh: 其他世界结果与停止条件
scenes.title_en: Other World Outcomes and Stop Conditions

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 约她出来的那些话，先都不说了。我去看了她，坐了一会儿，最后只问她今天缺什么。
lines.en: Let's set aside all those plans to get her out. I went to see her and sat with her for a while. In the end, I only asked what she needed today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她怎么说？
lines.en: What did she say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说让我陪她坐着就行。……我就一直坐着。
lines.en: She said sitting with her was enough. ...So I just sat there.

scenes.title_zh: 铭牌的延迟领取、补领与短回应
scenes.title_en: Delayed Collection, Replacement, and Short Responses for the Recommendation Plaque

blocks.label_zh: 之前选择暂存，现在领取

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上回那块牌子，还替我留着吗？
lines.en: Is that plaque from last time still being held for me?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 留着呢，底座都替你包好了。
lines.en: It's here. I even wrapped the base for you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天给我吧，货备了一些。
lines.en: Give it to me today. I've got some stock ready.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好！第一个认出它的人进门，记得告诉我。我想知道他头一句问的是什么。
lines.en: Good! When the first person who recognizes it comes in, tell me. I want to know what their first question is.

blocks.label_zh: 已经赠予、意外缺失后补领

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 牌子找不着了，柜台和仓库都翻过了。
lines.en: I can't find the plaque. I've searched the counter and the storeroom.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我再给你补一块。下回收起来，可别跟要卖的货混在一起。
lines.en: I'll get you another one. Next time put it away properly. Don't mix it in with the goods for sale.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回记住了。
lines.en: I'll remember this time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这几天换了批货，牌子先收起来了。
lines.en: I changed stock these past few days, so I put the plaque away for now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯，等有合适的再摆。你又没答应要把整家店改成上面那种样子。
lines.en: Mm, put it out again when you have something suitable. You never promised to turn the whole shop into one of those upstairs places.

blocks.label_zh: 亲密已确认时追加一次
blocks.label_en: Added Once When Intimacy Is Confirmed

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你呢？
lines.en: And you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又不是看见牌子才认得路。
lines.en: It's not like I need the plaque to find my way here.

blocks.label_zh: 只有基础业务，未到口碑阶段
blocks.label_en: Basic Business Only, No Reputation Stage Yet

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 先做合适的生意。别为了让我看见来了多少人，把你原来的生意都挤掉了。
lines.en: Do the business that suits you first. Don't push out your regular business just to show me how many people came.

blocks.label_zh: 库存不足时的首次提示
blocks.label_en: First Warning When Stock Is Insufficient

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人来是要看东西的，光看我的名字可没用。等有合适的货了再摆，省得他们站在窗外干猜。
lines.en: Customers come to see goods. My name alone won't do anything. Put it out when you have suitable stock, so they don't stand outside the window guessing.

scenes.title_en: The Two of Them Together

blocks.label_en: Daily 1: The Two of Them Together

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说今天只是来看看。
lines.en: She says she's only here to look today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你不也是？
lines.en: Aren't you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我是来看他的。我可没说“只是”。
lines.en: I'm here to see him. I never said 'only.'

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 椅子都在。
lines.en: There are chairs for everyone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 知道。这回用不着她替我找。
lines.en: I know. This time I don't need her to find one for me.

scenes.title_en: Lydia Alone

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我今天说了好多话。
lines.en: I talked a lot today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就在这儿歇会儿。
lines.en: Then rest here for a while.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你都不问我说了什么？
lines.en: Aren't you going to ask what I said?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等你想说了再说。
lines.en: Tell me when you want to.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……难怪最后连我都栽在你这儿。
lines.en: ...No wonder even I ended up falling for you.

scenes.title_en: Eleanor Alone

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她让我带句话。
lines.en: She asked me to pass along a message.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 什么话？
lines.en: What message?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 说她晚点再来。现在这会儿，是我的。
lines.en: She'll come later. Right now, this time is mine.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后半句也是她说的？
lines.en: Did she say the second half too?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 是我说的。不许删。
lines.en: I said it. Don't cut it.

scenes.title_en: Separate Plans

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天我们俩出去，你自己记得吃饭。
lines.en: The two of us are going out tomorrow. Remember to eat.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不带我？
lines.en: Not taking me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回是谁嫌我们挑东西挑太久？
lines.en: Who was it that complained we took too long shopping last time?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那给我带点好吃的回来。
lines.en: Then bring me back something good to eat.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个好办！
lines.en: That's easy!

scenes.title_en: In the Window and in the Shop

blocks.label_en: Daily 5: In the Window and in the Shop

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 刚才有人在外面盯着我的名字看。
lines.en: Someone was outside staring at my name just now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进来了吗？
lines.en: Did they come in?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 没有，先问我是不是本人。
lines.en: No. First they asked if I was the person herself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么说？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说是，然后让他看货，别光盯着我看。
lines.en: I said yes, then told him to look at the goods, not just at me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 越来越会做生意了。
lines.en: You're getting better at business.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我今天留出来的时间，可没打算全拿来替你招呼客人。
lines.en: I didn't set aside today's time just to greet customers for you.

scenes.title_en: The Reason to Come Back

blocks.label_en: Daily 6: The Reason to Come Back

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在上面讲你这儿的东西，讲得比讲自己新买的裙子还多。
lines.en: Upstairs, she talks about the things in your shop more than she talks about the new dresses she buys.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是因为有人问！
lines.en: That's because people ask!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没人问的时候呢？
lines.en: And when no one asks?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……也讲一点。你还不是一样，说是下来卖东西，坐下就不想走。
lines.en: ...I still talk about them a little. You're the same—you say you're coming down to sell goods, then you sit down and don't want to leave.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天都不急。
lines.en: No rush today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 知道。别的事我都办完了。
lines.en: I know. I've finished everything else.

scenes.title_en: One Item, Two Opinions

blocks.label_zh: 日常七：一件东西，两种意见

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个颜色好看。
lines.en: This color looks nice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先看能用多久。
lines.en: First look at how long it lasts.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我已经看过了！你们俩就不能有一回先信我？
lines.en: I already looked! Can't you two trust me first just once?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你说说。
lines.en: Then tell us.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把看出来的门道一条条说完，抬眼等着。埃莉诺拿起东西看了看，点了点头。*
lines.en: *She lists everything she noticed, one point at a time, then looks up and waits. Eleanor picks up the item, examines it, and nods.*

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这回挑得不错。
lines.en: Good pick this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……夸人就夸人，非得加个“这回”。
lines.en: ...If you're going to compliment me, just compliment me. You have to add 'this time.'

scenes.title_zh: 原版游戏结束时的追加文字
scenes.title_en: Additional Text at the Original Game Ending

blocks.label_zh: 双恋完成，玩家平安留站
blocks.label_en: Dual Romance Complete, Player Stays Safely

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺在上层区有了自己的位置。莉迪亚也开始把想逛的街、想吃的东西、想见的人，一样样放进自己的日子里。她们有时一起来，有时各自推门进来，谁先到，谁就先坐到你身边。
lines.en: Eleanor has her own place in the Upper Levels now. Lydia has also started making room in her days for the streets she wants to browse, the food she wants to try, and the people she wants to see. Sometimes they come together; sometimes each walks in on her own. Whoever arrives first sits down beside you first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 当铺还在下层区。上面有人问过，这两位小姐为什么总往那儿跑。埃莉诺说，她喜欢的人在那儿；莉迪亚笑着补了一句：我也是。
lines.en: The pawnshop is still in the Lower Levels. People upstairs have asked why these two young ladies keep going down there. Eleanor says the person she likes is there. Lydia smiles and adds: me too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 后来，店里一直摆着三把椅子。
lines.en: After that, there were always three chairs in the shop.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺的母亲仍在下层区生活。女儿常回去看她，这条路没有因为工作顺了、身边多了一个人就断掉。
lines.en: Eleanor's mother still lives in the Lower Levels. Her daughter often goes back to see her. That road didn't disappear just because work improved and there was one more person at her side.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 撤案结果已发布时沿用现有已撤案尾声；未发布时只按实际提交状态描述，不以三人恋爱替官方下结论。
lines.en: If the case-withdrawal result has been published, use the existing withdrawal epilogue. If not, describe only the actual submission status; the three-person romance does not make an official conclusion on its behalf.

blocks.label_zh: 双恋已确认，本线第20章尚未播放
blocks.label_en: Dual Romance Confirmed, Chapter 20 Not Yet Played

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 三个人已经把心意说开了，往后还有好多日子要一起学着过。她们各有各的生活和脾气，也开始认真给彼此留出时间。那顿谁都不用先走的饭，还在等一个合适的晚上。
lines.en: The three of them have said what they feel. There are still many days ahead to learn how to live together. Each has her own life and temper, and they've started seriously setting aside time for one another. The meal where no one has to leave first is still waiting for the right evening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 使用原埃莉诺恋爱尾声，可追加：莉迪亚已经把真话说出了口，可三个人还没一起拿定主意。不把一次坦白写成已经开始的双人恋爱。
lines.en: Use the original Eleanor romance epilogue, with this possible addition: Lydia has spoken the truth, but the three of them haven't decided together yet. A single confession is not written as an already-begun two-person romance.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 原埃莉诺恋人尾声不降级。莉迪亚的感情按实际收束保留，不追加“她仍在等玩家回心转意”。
lines.en: The original Eleanor-lover epilogue is not downgraded. Lydia's feelings remain as actually concluded, without adding 'she is still waiting for the player to change his mind.'

blocks.label_en: Player Leaves the Station, Dual Romance Confirmed

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她们一起替你清点了能带走的东西，又各自把自己的安排告诉你。能不能同行，要看各自的手续和处境，不是一句舍不得就能办成的。临走前，两个人都叮嘱你：到了地方，消息要发给她们俩，不许只告诉一个。
lines.en: Together they inventory what you can take with you, then each tells you her own arrangements. Whether they can go with you depends on their papers and circumstances; a few words of reluctance can't make it happen. Before you leave, both of them tell you: when you get there, send word to both of us. Don't tell only one.

blocks.label_zh: 玩家被捕或失去自由，双恋已确认
blocks.label_en: Player Arrested or Deprived of Freedom, Dual Romance Confirmed

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺去查你被关在哪儿，莉迪亚去找能问得上话的人。认识几个上层区的人，并不能保证把你放出来；可谁要是只给一句含糊的“再等等”，她们谁都不肯收下。原版的结果不被新路线抹去。
lines.en: Eleanor tries to find out where you're being held, and Lydia looks for someone who can get answers. Knowing a few people in the Upper Levels doesn't guarantee getting you out, but neither of them accepts a vague 'wait a little longer' from anyone. The original outcome is not erased by the new route.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 后来，她们一起回来过一次。莉迪亚这回什么都没说，埃莉诺也没催她。两个人把柜台边的椅子摆好，坐了一会儿，然后一起离开。人回不来了，日子还得她们自己过下去。
lines.en: Later, they came back together once. Lydia said nothing this time, and Eleanor didn't rush her. The two of them set the chairs by the counter in order, sat for a while, and then left together. You weren't coming back, and they still had to go on living their own lives.

blocks.label_zh: 铭牌经营追加：已陈列并有真实引荐成交
blocks.label_en: Plaque Business Addition: Displayed With Actual Referral Sales

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 橱窗里的署名，曾让一些人愿意下楼来看看。后来他们说起这家店，说的是买回去的东西。莉迪亚每回听见都要跑来告诉你，得意是得意，却再也不用拿这件事当来找你的理由。
lines.en: The signature in the showcase once made some people willing to come downstairs and look. Later, when they talked about the shop, they talked about what they'd bought. Every time Lydia heard that, she'd run over and tell you. She was proud, but she no longer needed it as an excuse to come see you.

blocks.label_zh: 已经取得，但没有陈列或经营尚未做成
blocks.label_en: Obtained but Not Displayed, or Business Not Yet Completed

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那块小牌子还在你那儿收着。有没有靠它做成生意是一回事；她为什么想来，她早就亲口说过了。
lines.en: That little plaque is still tucked away with you. Whether it ever brought in business is one thing; why she wanted to come, she already told you herself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她没把这段关系写进橱窗里。想见你的时候，她自己推门进来。
lines.en: She didn't write this relationship into the showcase. When she wants to see you, she walks through the door herself.

scenes.title_en: She Was Eleanor's Friend First

blocks.label_zh: 共同第10章：对阶层偏见的修正
blocks.label_en: Common Chapter 10: Correcting the Class Prejudice

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她以前老说，回上面找个熟人，总比在下面求人强。
lines.en: She used to say going back upstairs to find someone she knew was always better than begging for help down here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在呢？
lines.en: And now?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在会先问我要她帮什么了。问完，还是忍不住添两句自己的主意。
lines.en: Now she asks what I need help with first. After that, she still can't resist adding a couple of ideas of her own.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你让她添？
lines.en: You let her?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让啊。她有时候说得也对，我又不是只会跟她吵。
lines.en: I do. Sometimes she's right. It's not like all I do is argue with her.

blocks.label_zh: 救母前已有传话中的短段
blocks.label_en: Short Segment in an Existing Message Delivery Before the Rescue

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她今天是不是又没怎么吃东西？我想拉她去以前常去的那家，她说没胃口。
lines.en: She barely ate again today, didn't she? I wanted to take her to that place we used to go, but she said she had no appetite.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她现在心里只有她母亲。
lines.en: Her mother is all she can think about right now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道。一开始我还以为，陪她买点东西、逗她笑一笑就好了。现在才明白，有些事不是我多说几句就能过去的。
lines.en: I know. At first I thought buying her a few things and making her laugh would be enough. I understand now that some things won't pass just because I talk more.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别逼她高兴。问问她今天缺什么。
lines.en: Don't force her to be happy. Ask what she needs today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。这回我先听她说。
lines.en: Mm. This time I'll listen to her first.

blocks.label_zh: 共同第21章：正常探望，先说朋友
blocks.label_en: Common Chapter 21: A Normal Visit, Friendship First

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来挑了个特别漂亮的摆件。埃莉诺一看，就问这东西能不能烧水。
lines.en: I picked out a really beautiful ornament. Eleanor took one look and asked whether it could boil water.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么说？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不能啊！我还想说好看也算有用。后来她把要买的东西写给我，我才发现她那儿缺的东西还真不少。
lines.en: It can't! I was going to say looking good counts as useful too. Then she wrote down what she needed, and I realized she was missing quite a lot.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以换了？
lines.en: So you changed it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 换了。她挑结实的，我在结实的里头挑最好看的。总不能连这点都不让我管吧。
lines.en: I changed it. She picks the sturdy ones, and I pick the best-looking among the sturdy ones. She can't stop me from having at least that much say.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她怎么说？
lines.en: What did she say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说我总算把聪明用对了地方。……从她嘴里出来的夸奖，就是这个样子。
lines.en: She said I'd finally put my brains to good use. ...That's what praise sounds like from her.

blocks.label_zh: 普通恋人，未进入本扩展
blocks.label_en: Ordinary Lovers, Did Not Enter This Expansion

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她告诉我，你们在一起了。
lines.en: She told me you two are together.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你看起来一点都不意外。
lines.en: You don't look surprised at all.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她以前看上一件衣服，嘴上会先嫌袖口不好看。现在说起你，也是先挑三件毛病，再说今天还想下来。
lines.en: When she used to like a dress, she'd start by complaining the cuffs looked wrong. Now when she talks about you, she lists three faults first, then says she wants to come down again today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你当面跟她说了？
lines.en: Did you say that to her face?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说了。她差点把手里的发夹塞我嘴里。
lines.en: I did. She nearly stuffed her hair clip in my mouth.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好好过吧。她来抱怨，我听着；你们的恋爱，我可不替你们谈。
lines.en: Live well together. If she comes to complain, I'll listen. But I'm not handling your romance for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说你们把话说开了，以后还是朋友。
lines.en: She said you two talked it out and will stay friends.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就不瞎猜了。以前我总觉得，见得多了、肯帮忙了，就该往那个方向走。
lines.en: Then I'll stop guessing. I used to think that if we saw enough of each other and I was willing to help, it had to lead in that direction.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 也可以只是朋友。
lines.en: It can also just be friendship.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 知道了。这个故事的结局，轮不到我来写。
lines.en: I know. It's not my turn to write the ending of this story.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后看到合适的东西，我还会来问价。这回先看东西，再听故事。
lines.en: If I see something suitable in the future, I'll still come ask the price. This time I'll look at the item first and hear the story second.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 价钱不合适，也可以不买。
lines.en: If the price doesn't suit you, you can walk away.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这还用你教？我就是看到漂亮的，会多犹豫一会儿。
lines.en: Do you need to teach me that? I just hesitate a little longer when something's pretty.

blocks.label_zh: 侍从线：莉迪亚听说“主人”

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她真那么叫你？
lines.en: She really calls you that?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她告诉你的？
lines.en: Did she tell you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说漏嘴了。我追着问，她就岔开话，最后还怪我笑得太明显。
lines.en: She let it slip. I kept asking, she changed the subject, and then she blamed me for smiling too obviously.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你笑了？
lines.en: You smiled?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一点点。……好吧，不止一点。认识她这么多年，我还没听她把这种话说得这么认真。
lines.en: A little. ...All right, more than a little. I've known her all these years, and I've never heard her say something like that so seriously.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我没跟别人说。她肯告诉我，我就替她守着。
lines.en: I haven't told anyone. If she trusts me with it, I'll keep it for her.

blocks.label_zh: 侍从线第22章：空职位介绍来源替换
blocks.label_en: Attendant Route Chapter 22: Source of the Empty Position Replaced

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚在熟悉的店里替我问过。人家说可以先留个位置，具体做什么以后再说。她一听有机会，高兴得当天就跑来找我。
lines.en: Lydia asked at a shop she knows, on my behalf. They said they could hold a position for now and decide the details later. The moment she heard there was an opening, she was so happy she ran to find me that same day.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你问清楚了？
lines.en: Did you ask for details?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 问了，她也陪我去问的。后来她才明白，我不是非要跟她的好意作对——我得知道自己进去了能干什么。
lines.en: I did, and she came with me to ask. That was when she understood I wasn't trying to oppose her goodwill—I need to know what I'll actually be doing there.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就找肯让你干活的地方。
lines.en: Then find a place that will let you do real work.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。她说下回先问清楚，不拿一句“都可以”当好消息。
lines.en: Mm. She said next time she'll ask clearly first, and not treat 'anything works' as good news.

blocks.label_zh: 路线丙：失去母亲后的来访
blocks.label_en: Route C: A Visit After Losing Her Mother

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她今天没问你有没有注意到她的新衣服。进门以后，她先把小包放稳，才开口。*
lines.en: *She doesn't ask whether you noticed her new clothes today. After coming in, she sets her small bag down carefully before speaking.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我去看过她了。想了好多话，坐下来一句都没说出来。
lines.en: I went to see her. I thought of so many things to say, and once I sat down, I couldn't say a single one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 陪着就好。
lines.en: Just being there is enough.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。后来她让我递一样东西给她，我才知道手该往哪儿放。
lines.en: Mm. Later she asked me to hand her something, and only then did I know what to do with my hands.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说以后有自己的打算。要是以前，我肯定先劝她别去。现在……我想先听她把话说完。
lines.en: She says she has her own plans for the future. Before, I definitely would've tried to talk her out of it first. Now... I want to hear her out first.
